headline: Pending home
sales hit
a record low
in September
slides.subtitle:
Mortgage rates near 7.4%
are squeezing buyers

slides.title: What happened
slides.body: The NAR index dropped to 66.0, its lowest since tracking began in 2001. It is down 11.3% from a year ago.
slides.source: Source: National Association of Realtors, Oct. 20, 2026

slides.title: The numbers
slides.subtitle: 30-year mortgage rate (Freddie Mac)
slides.source: Source: Freddie Mac. Actual figures, not forecasts.

slides.title: Why it matters
slides.body: Higher borrowing costs keep buyers on the sidelines. Contracts signed now point to fewer closings in coming months.

slides.title: The bottom line
items: Pending sales fell 7.3% to a record low of 66.0
slides.disclaimer: For informational purposes only. Not investment advice.
